_help: Pitlane HQ Pro. The admin page switches Pro on when the beta ends, with 1.0 (until then everything is free). Prices are the owner's (Nov 1 2026): $6 a month, $59 a year. `trialDays`: every account made once Pro is on has Pro for that many days. `launch.thanksMonths`: the months of Pro everyone who had an account during the beta gets the day Pro is switched on. `founding`: whoever supported Pitlane HQ during the beta with `min` dollars or more in all keeps Pro at `off` percent less, and may buy Pro for life (`lifetime`) in the first `months` months after the beta. Stripe charges (Managed Payments); the server hears of each purchase through POST /stripe/webhook (secret STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET). The checkout links (`buy`) are empty until the store opens.

lifetime._help: Pro for life, for founding supporters only, in the first two months after the beta.

donate._help: The Support button: buy is the Stripe Payment Link (the customer chooses the amount), link its id (plink_...). A donation gives the Supporter badge, never Pro; donations of founding.min dollars or more in all also give the founding supporter offer.

invite._help: Invite a friend (cloud/src/referrals.js): a friend who signed up with a driver's link or code and used Pitlane HQ on `days` different days, with at least `drives` sessions driven, within `within` days of signing up gives both a month of Pro (`months`). Earned during the beta, the months are kept and start when Pro is switched on. An inviter earns at most `max` months a year; the friend always gets theirs. A friend types a code only in their first `claimDays` days.
